result.releaseSummary: Added concurrent Blob CAS write tests and improved error handling for cost updates. Implemented admin-only reporting dashboard for manual accounting without affecting provider billing.
risks: Potential broken routes in the new API endpoints.
Admin authentication leaks if not properly tested.
OpenAI API issues due to changes in data handling.
Data loss risks during concurrent writes.
Performance issues with new cost calculations.
smokeTests: Verify that the new API endpoints return expected responses.
Check that admin-only routes are inaccessible to non-admin users.
regressionTests: Run existing tests to ensure no other functionalities are broken.
Test all API routes for proper authentication and authorization.
edgeCases: Test concurrent writes to ensure only one succeeds.
Check behavior when invalid data is sent to the API.
adminChecks: Ensure admin-only access is enforced on all new routes.
Verify that financial data is not exposed to non-admin users.
thirdPartyChecks: Confirm that no new provider calls are made without proper authentication.
Check that existing provider integrations remain unaffected.

rollbackSteps: Revert the feature commit via PR.
Ensure the additive store is retained.
